subject: Scantwopermhk P-value Summary list/double parameter error

messages.author: 56e965b463056024
messages.subject: Scantwopermhk P-value Summary list/double parameter error
parts:
Sorry for a purely data structure/troubleshooting question, but I've been having errors using scantwoperm output in generating thresholds/significance for a scantwo result as below. Summary works fine on either 'perms.w4' or 's2weight' independently, but gives the error for any use of 'perms=', whether with a scantwoperm directly from scantwopermhk (10 permutations) or with 100 of such combined with c()

> summary(s2weight,lodcolumn=4,perms=perms.wk4,pvalues=TRUE,alphas=c(0.2,0.2,0.0,0.2,0.2))
Error in summary.scantwo(s2weight, lodcolumn = 4, perms = perms.wk4, pvalues = TRUE,  : 
  (list) object cannot be coerced to type 'double'

Any help would be very appreciated, let me know if more info is needed!

Generation of the objects:
s2weight<-scantwo(gprobf2,method="hk",pheno.col=c(1:16),addcovar=acovar,verbose=FALSE)
perm<-scantwopermhk(gprobf2,pheno.col = pheno,addcovar = acovar,n.perm = numPerms,perm.Xsp = TRUE,verbose=FALSE)
